name: Right Click Harvest
summary: Right-click a mature crop to harvest it and automatically replant. With the pack config, no hoe is needed, hoes harvest a larger area depending on tier, and harvesting costs no hunger or XP.

mechanics.title: Pack configuration
mechanics.description: requireHoe = false (any item or empty hand can harvest), harvestInRadius = true (higher tier hoes harvest more blocks around the target), hungerLevel = NONE, experienceType = NONE. These match the mod defaults.

mechanics.title: Harvesting
mechanics.description: Works on vanilla crops including cocoa beans, nether wart, sugar cane and cactus, and most modded crops. Fortune on a hoe increases yield. Block and item tags can customise behaviour.

vanilla_changes.change: Harvests the crop and replants instead of doing nothing.

editor_notes: Pack config only restates the defaults. Verify sugar cane/cactus behaviour in 26.2 build.
